summary: First-run full-stack testing of CaterNation. Backend (pytest 7/7 passed) covers /api/content GET, /api/auth/login (200 + 401), /api/auth/me (with/without token), /api/content PUT persistence (with/without token), /api/content/reset. Frontend end-to-end validated: hero heading 'Fine Catering' + overline 'Amritsar', hero-call-btn/tel: and hero-whatsapp-btn/wa.me, floating buttons with correct tel:+916284649883 and wa.me/916284649883 hrefs, gradual scroll reveals all 7 sections (about/services/dishes/counters/gallery/testimonials/contact), 6 service cards, owner-card-o1 (Vivek) and owner-card-o2 (Jatin), contact-map iframe, gallery 12 items filtered down to 3 for Weddings, lightbox open/next/prev/close all functional. Admin flow: login at /admin/login navigates to /admin, all sidebar tabs present (brand/contact/hero/marquee/about/services/dishes/counters/gallery/testimonials/sections), edit hero overline + Publish shows success and public site reflects change, sections tab toggle-testimonials + Publish hides testimonials-section on public site, Reset restores defaults (edited overline gone, testimonials section back). No pricing/booking/quote/enquiry forms detected.

issues: Non-blocking console warning from a scroll library: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position (relative/fixed/absolute) to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' Consider adding position:relative to the scroll container to silence.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: get_content auto-inserts DEFAULT_CONTENT on first GET without auth — acceptable but note it means public GET can trigger a write; low risk.
server.py: admin password startup update path always overwrites when password differs, which is correct for env-driven credential rotation.
seed_content.py: consider marking gallery images with dimensions/lazy-load hints in payload for CMS-side lazy loading configurability.
Frontend Lenis scroll warning about non-static container position should be resolved by setting position:relative on the wrapping element.
seed_data_creation: None; used default seeded content and reset via /api/content/reset and admin Reset button.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression tests at /app/backend/tests/test_caternation_api.py. Admin edits temporarily change content; tests already reset content afterward. Public site uses Lenis smooth scroll + framer-motion whileInView reveals — must gradually scroll (not jump) to trigger section rendering when validating DOM presence via data-testid.
